principles: Shift-left: fail non-English author artifacts at the moment of authoring, not at the REVIEW->TEST gate
Reuse the existing detectCjk predicate so early check and gate always agree
Scan only author-controlled artifacts; never code/runtime files
drivers: The english-artifacts gate only runs at REVIEW->TEST -> wasted round-trip (happened on B-191c)
A duplicate CJK regex would let the early check and the gate drift
Must not over-reach into code/runtime files

options.name: Call detectCjk in story_create + background_set/append
pros: Reuses the single canonical predicate (no drift)
Fails at authoring with a precise message
Minimal: two author entry points + a smoke
cons: Touches two handlers + adds a small refusal helper

options.name: Add a new containsCJK to english-artifact-gate.ts
cons: core/cjk-detect.ts already IS the canonical predicate; adding another export is redundant

options.name: Leave it at the REVIEW->TEST gate only

rationale: core/cjk-detect.ts detectCjk is already the canonical CJK predicate used by the REVIEW->TEST gate; calling it at the author entry points (story_create + background_set/append) shifts the failure left with zero risk of drift between the early check and the gate, and the smallest blast radius.

preMortem.scenario: The early check and the REVIEW->TEST gate disagree (early rejects content the gate would pass, or vice versa)
preMortem.trigger: Using a different/duplicate CJK predicate at authoring time
preMortem.consequence: A story that passes story_create still fails the gate, or legitimate English is wrongly refused
preMortem.mitigation: Reuse the EXACT detectCjk from core/cjk-detect.ts (the gate uses it too); a smoke asserts agreement — content the early check rejects is exactly content runEnglishArtifactGate would flag

preMortem.scenario: A false positive flags legitimate English (em-dash, smart quotes) and blocks normal story_create
preMortem.consequence: Operators cannot create normal English stories
preMortem.mitigation: detectCjk only matches CJK unicode ranges; a smoke asserts an all-English story_create incl. U+2014 em-dash succeeds

preMortem.scenario: The scan over-reaches into code/runtime content
preMortem.mitigation: Limit the scan to background + checklist title/context/userSees + title/description only; a smoke asserts the scope
